conflicts.detail: Template source v1.2.0 introduces a default middleware on a Mixed-ownership path, but no Sync seam is registered for this file and the Derived project already has its own implementation. Engine must report this and refuse to silently merge. Issue #35 documents this as the negative case that justifies the new product-module-registration seam on apps/api/products.ts: the right fix is to register an explicit seam, not to mark apps/api/middleware.ts Custom-owned.

recommendation.note: One Sync conflict (apps/api/middleware.ts) requires an explicit decision. After resolving, apply proceeds on a branch and the Environment contract update is included automatically. Two Template migrations are pending manual execution on the apply branch: rotate-webhook-signing-secret (interactive, destructive) and register-trusted-only-secrets-bundle (trusted-only). One migration is already applied (marker-environments-contract-v1.2.0) and only surfaced for visibility. Three Sync seams preserve the Derived project's wiring: api-route-registration and product-route-registration on apps/api/routes.ts, and product-module-registration on apps/api/products.ts.
